createEnrichment.title: Create an enrichment
createEnrichment.description: Create the questions you want candidates to answer and the window they are contacted in. It is created once and never edited: different questions mean a new enrichment. Returns `enrichment_id`. Record prepares translations and voice in the background: read the enrichment until `questions_status` is `ready`.

fields.name: Display name, 1–120 characters.
fields.external_id: Your own id (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -, up to 128). Unique per organisation and mode.
fields.delivery: Optional. WhatsApp and the AI voice call are always on. Send `sms_backup: true` to also send an SMS with the link.
fields.schedule: Required. Send all six: `language` (english, hindi, tamil, kannada, telugu, malayalam, bengali, marathi), `start_time` and `end_time` ("HH:MM", start before end), `days` (mon…sun, each once), `timezone` (IANA), `max_retries` 1 to 20, `retry_after_hours` 1 to 48.
fields.questions: Required. 1 to 15 of `{ question_text, type, preferred_answer?, required? }`. `type` is `yes_no` (needs `preferred_answer`) or `voice`. `required` defaults to true.

errors: `name`, `schedule` or `questions` missing, a `yes_no` question without `preferred_answer`, `start_time` not before `end_time`, an unknown language, empty or repeated `days`, or an unknown field.
`external_id` is already used by another enrichment.

listEnrichments.title: List enrichments
listEnrichments.description: List your organisation's enrichments, made here or on the Enrichment page of the playground (`is_external` says which), newest first.

getEnrichment.title: Get an enrichment
getEnrichment.description: One enrichment with its questions. Use it to wait for `questions_status` to reach `ready`.
errors: No such enrichment in your organisation and mode.

archiveEnrichment.title: Archive an enrichment
archiveEnrichment.description: Archive an enrichment you created. It is not erased: its campaigns, candidates and results stay readable. Campaigns that are already live keep running, so pause them first if they should stop. Archiving again changes nothing.
errors: The enrichment was made in the playground. The API changes only what it created.

getEnrichmentOverview.title: Get the overview of an enrichment
getEnrichmentOverview.description: Funnel numbers across all campaigns: uploaded, rejected, sent, delivered, link opened, completed and opted out, and how many candidates stand in each status.

createEnrichmentCampaign.title: Create a campaign
createEnrichmentCampaign.description: Add candidates (name and mobile number) to one of your enrichments. Record starts contacting them straight away: there is no separate start step. If the questions are still being prepared, the campaign waits and goes out by itself. Returns `campaign_id`, the candidates and every row that was skipped.

fields.name: Campaign name, 1–200 characters.
fields.language: Optional invite language. Defaults to the enrichment's schedule language.
fields.candidates: Required. 1 to 1,000 of `{ name, phone_number, external_id? }`. `phone_number` is an Indian mobile: 10 digits, or with `+91`. A row with an invalid number, a number that opted out, or a number already earlier in the list is skipped and returned in `skipped`; it never fails the call. `external_id` comes back on every candidate and result.

errors: No candidate has a contactable number (`details` say why), or a field is missing or unknown.
The enrichment was made in the playground, or a TEST key would exceed 50 candidates in this enrichment.
No such enrichment, or it is archived.

listEnrichmentCampaigns.title: List campaigns
listEnrichmentCampaigns.description: The campaigns of an enrichment, newest first, with how many candidates were sent to and finished.

getEnrichmentCampaign.title: Get a campaign
getEnrichmentCampaign.description: Progress of one campaign: the funnel, numbers per channel and where candidates drop off per question.

pauseEnrichmentCampaign.title: Pause a campaign
pauseEnrichmentCampaign.description: Stop everything still to go out (invites, follow-ups, SMS, calls) until you resume. Only a live campaign can be paused.
errors: The enrichment was made in the playground.

resumeEnrichmentCampaign.title: Resume a campaign
resumeEnrichmentCampaign.description: Carry on where the campaign stopped. Only a paused campaign can be resumed.
errors: The enrichment was made in the playground.

listEnrichmentCandidates.title: List candidates
listEnrichmentCandidates.description: Every candidate of an enrichment and where each stands. Phone numbers are returned in full. Filter by campaign, status or a part of the name or number.

getEnrichmentCandidate.title: Get a candidate
getEnrichmentCandidate.description: One candidate in full: what was sent and when, every answer, and the result once they finish. The English transcript of a spoken answer is translated the first time it is read, so that read can be slower.

listEnrichmentResults.title: List results
listEnrichmentResults.description: The final result of each candidate who finished or declined, newest first. A result is written once and never changes. Answers are self-reported and not verified.

createWebhookEndpoint.title: Create an endpoint
createWebhookEndpoint.description: Register the HTTPS URL that receives each candidate's result as soon as they finish an enrichment. Send `event_types: ["enrichment.result"]`: enrichment results are opt-in, and the key needs an enrichment scope as well as `webhooks:manage`. Deliveries are signed with your API secret key and retried until you answer `2xx`.

fields.url: HTTPS, port 443, a public host. Any 2xx answer counts as the acknowledgement.
fields.event_types: `["enrichment.result"]` for enrichment results. Leave out for `candidate.result` only (Blue Collar verification results). Both can be listed.
fields.backfill_from: ISO date-time: also send results from then on (at most 30 days back).

errors: URL not https, a private address, a port other than 443, or an unknown event type.

listWebhookEndpoints.title: List endpoints
listWebhookEndpoints.description: Each endpoint with its status (`active`, `paused`, `auto_paused`), consecutive failures and last success.

getWebhookEndpoint.title: Get an endpoint
getWebhookEndpoint.description: One endpoint with its current status.

updateWebhookEndpoint.title: Update an endpoint
updateWebhookEndpoint.description: Send only what changes. `status: paused` holds deliveries (nothing is lost); `status: active` resumes them, oldest first. Use it to bring back an `auto_paused` endpoint.
errors: No field sent, or a bad URL.

deleteWebhookEndpoint.title: Delete an endpoint
deleteWebhookEndpoint.description: Deliveries still waiting for it stop. The events stay in the feed for 30 days.

testWebhookEndpoint.title: Send a test event
testWebhookEndpoint.description: Sends a signed `webhook.test` event right now and shows what your server answered. Use it to check your URL and signature code before any candidate answers. It is not an `enrichment.result`, and it is not stored or retried.

backfillWebhookEndpoint.title: Backfill past results
backfillWebhookEndpoint.description: Queues the `enrichment.result` events since `from` (at most 30 days back) as normal deliveries. Use it to replay results your server missed. Safe to repeat.

listWebhookDeliveries.title: List deliveries
listWebhookDeliveries.description: Every send to this endpoint, newest first: attempts, last HTTP status or error, when the next retry is due.

retryWebhookDelivery.title: Retry a delivery
retryWebhookDelivery.description: For a dead one after you fixed your endpoint. Its attempts count from zero again.

pullEvents.title: Pull and confirm events
pullEvents.description: Use this when you cannot expose a URL, or as a safety net next to the webhook. Send `type: "enrichment.result"`, and the `ack` ids of the events you already processed, and get the next events back. Needs `events:read` and an enrichment scope.

fields.ack: Ids of the events you processed. Leave it empty on your first call.
fields.status: `unacked` (default) gives only events you have not confirmed. `all` replays history (use it with `from`).
fields.from: Only events created at or after this time (replay).
fields.after: Only events with a higher `sequence` than this. A paging shortcut: rely on `unacked`.

errors: An `ack` id that is not an event id, more than 100 ids, a bad date, or `limit` above 100.

getEvent.title: Get an event
getEvent.description: Fetch one event by its id.
errors: No such event (or older than 30 days).
